# pheno-scaffold-kit

Scaffold umbrella CLI wrapping 5 pheno-* AI-DD crutch libs:

- pheno-agents-md — generates AGENTS.md
- pheno-llms-txt — generates llms.txt
- pheno-prompt-test — prompt regression harness
- pheno-vibecoding-guard — pre-commit agent-drift guard
- pheno-worklog-schema — WORKLOG.md validation

## Install

```bash
pip install pheno-scaffold-kit
```

## Usage

```bash
# Detect repo + run all 5 scaffold steps
pheno-scaffold init /path/to/repo

# Or run individual steps
pheno-scaffold init-agents /path/to/repo
pheno-scaffold init-llms /path/to/repo
pheno-scaffold init-prompt-test /path/to/repo
pheno-scaffold install-hooks /path/to/repo
pheno-scaffold init-worklog /path/to/repo
```

## Public API

```python
from pheno_scaffold_kit import init_scaffold, detect_repo_type

print(detect_repo_type("/path/to/repo"))
# {'exists': True, 'git': True, 'python': True, ...}

print(init_scaffold("/path/to/repo"))
# {'agents': {...}, 'llms': {...}, 'prompt_test': {...}, ...}
```

## Sub-library contract

Each sub-lib is imported lazily + defensively — umbrella works even if
0/5 sub-libs are installed. Tests use `monkeypatch.setattr` to mock.
